items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Who was the trombone player? Used to be the business manager of the union.

ctx.x: You can tell us a little bit about that.

He was a piano player, a very good piano player, by the name of Diaz, who afterwards went to New York and played commercial music, and I guess he made a lot of money, and I don't blame him for playing commercial music. Hooray for him. He wasn't going to get stuck with this damn fool jazz business, you know, give your soul away and get nothing back. The hell with that. Diaz, who played a beautiful jazz piano, and Monk Hazel was on drums. Elry Mazin on clarinet, much to his disgust, since he was a saxophone player,…
